official_sources.verified_fact: EA LIDAR Composite DTM 1m covers about 99% of England, EPSG:27700, removes surface objects, reports +/-15cm RMSE, and uses newest/best resolution where repeat surveys exist.
EA LIDAR Composite DSM 1m includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain; not interchangeable with DTM.
Time Stamped Point Cloud metadata includes survey flown start/end date and average point density; classified ground points need not match manually edited final DTM.
Ground truth points are +/-3cm RMSE; LIDAR surveys must report less than +/-15cm RMSE and 10cm standard deviation/random error to pass QC.

quality_effect: blocks DSM/object heights, stale survey epochs and point-cloud/raw-ground substitutions from being treated as final terrain elevation
